'''Falco''', ostensibly "Captain" Falco, was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|human]] high-ranking officer in the [[Human League]] serving [[Thrackan Sal-Solo]] during the [[Corellian Crisis|First Corellian Insurrection]].

==Biography==
He served on Thrackan's self-styled "[[Honor Detail]]." On Thrackan's orders, he released a [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] prisoner named [[Dracmus]] to fight [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] for the League officers' amusement.
